inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL update workflow derives a scalar aggregate for every row, assigns a CASE-based status, copies values through an INNER JOIN, and applies an ORDER BY/LIMIT mutation to the highest-valued row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a campaign-metrics refresh. A fixed average budget fills a reserve column, quota drives a CASE status, a joined rating table supplies ratings, and only the highest-budget campaign is featured; the source tables, identifiers, values, and product tutorial data are not copied.

fixture_notes: All campaigns receive the same reserve computed from the pre-update average budget. Quotas split campaigns into ready/watch, ratings exist only for campaigns 101 and 102, and the highest-budget campaign 101 alone becomes featured.
determinism_notes: The aggregate runs before any budget mutation, each campaign has at most one rating row, the highest budget is unique, and final reads use primary-key ordering; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE campaign_metrics (campaign_id INT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, budget DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, reserve DECIMAL(10,2) NULL, quota INT NOT NULL, campaign_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, rating TINYINT NULL)
CREATE TABLE campaign_ratings (rating_id INT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_id INT NOT NULL, rating TINYINT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO campaign_metrics VALUES (101, 'Aurora', 900.00, NULL, 24, 'new', NULL), (102, 'Beacon', 450.00, NULL, 11, 'new', NULL), (103, 'Cedar', 700.00, NULL, 18, 'new', NULL), (104, 'Drift', 300.00, NULL, 7, 'new', NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE campaign_metrics SET reserve = (SELECT AVG(budget) FROM campaign_metrics) * 0.10
UPDATE campaign_metrics SET campaign_state = CASE WHEN quota > 15 THEN 'ready' ELSE 'watch' END
UPDATE campaign_metrics INNER JOIN campaign_ratings ON campaign_metrics.campaign_id = campaign_ratings.campaign_id SET campaign_metrics.rating = campaign_ratings.rating
UPDATE campaign_metrics SET campaign_state = 'featured' WHERE campaign_state = 'ready' ORDER BY budget DESC, campaign_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT campaign_id, campaign_state, reserve, rating FROM campaign_metrics ORDER BY campaign_id
